name: Sandbox detonation completed
description: Start a playbook run whenever a PolySwarm sandbox detonation finishes. The trigger polls the sandbox tasks created by the configured PolySwarm account and emits one event per task that reaches a terminal status, carrying the hash, the sandbox provider, the status, the task identifier and where the report can be fetched. PolySwarm lists only the ten newest tasks and cannot page further, so a task that is still running when it leaves that page is followed by its own identifier until it finishes. A task that is created, finishes and leaves the page between two polls is never seen and produces no event; the trigger logs a warning when the page suggests this happened, and a shorter poll frequency narrows the gap. Identifiers already emitted are persisted, so a restart does not replay them. The first poll after a fresh start records the tasks that have already finished without emitting events for them. The report body itself is not embedded: call the Report action with the sha256 and sandbox from the event to retrieve it.

frequency.description: Seconds to wait between two polls of the PolySwarm sandbox task list

sandbox.description: Only emit events for this sandbox provider slug, for example 'cape' or 'triage'. Leave empty to emit for every provider.

emit_failed.description: Emit an event for detonations that ended in FAILED as well as SUCCEEDED

max_tasks_per_cycle.description: How many still running sandbox tasks to look up by identifier on each poll, in addition to the newest page of ten. A task that is running when it falls off the newest page is followed here until it finishes. When more tasks than this are running at once, the ones not checked this poll are checked on the next, so those completions are late.

sandbox.description: Sandbox provider that ran the detonation

status.description: Terminal status of the task, SUCCEEDED or FAILED

community.description: PolySwarm community the task ran in

instance_id.description: Artifact instance the detonation belongs to

created.description: When the task was created, as reported by PolySwarm

expiration.description: When PolySwarm expires the task, if it reports one

report_available.description: Whether a report can be fetched for this detonation. The event never carries the report itself: fetch it with the Report action using the sha256 and sandbox from this event

report_url.description: PolySwarm API URL that returns this sandbox task and its report

portal_url.description: PolySwarm portal page for the artifact instance

sandbox_artifact_count.description: Number of artifacts the detonation produced

detected_at.description: When the trigger observed the task as complete, UTC, ISO 8601
